Name: Desert Obelisk
Author: CatCattyCat
Description:
[size=6]Desert Obelisk[/size]
[size=3]
[b][size=6]***SDV 1.4 added in an obelisk to teleport you to the desert. This mod isn't needed in 1.4 (only unhidden for people still playing in 1.3)[/size][/b]****


This mod  adds a desert obelisk that you [u]buy from the wizard[/u] which lets you warp to the desert! It costs 1,000,000g (like the other obelisks), 10 Iridium Bars, and 10 Solar Essence. [u]Note that it only unlocks when you have access to the desert[/u].
[/size]
[size=3][u]For Starblue Valley users:[/u][/size]
[size=3]This mod is also compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1869]Starblue Valley[/url] by default (if you have Starblue Valley installed, you don't need to do anything and the obelisk will match Starblue's color scheme).[/size]

[size=3][u]For Content Pack creators:[/u][/size]
[size=3]This mod supports content packs! Simply create a content pack that has a 'Desert Obelisk.png' image file inside an assets folder in your content pack, and the mod will load that as the obelisk image.[/size]

[size=4][b]A craftable desert warp totem will be added to this mod after the multiplayer update comes out. Sorry that I couldn't add it now![/b][/size]

[size=3]Requires [/size][url=https://smapi.io]SMAPI v2.5+[/url][size=3] by Pathoschild. Huge thanks to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/users/51777556]Minerva [/url]for creating all the sprites![/size]

[size=3]Place the DesertObelisk folder inside of your Stardew Valley/Mods folder to install.[/size]

[b][size=6]**In multiplayer, the host [u]must[/u] have the mod installed for the game to not crash at the end of the day. Farmhands need the mod to be able to also build the obelisk.**[/size][/b]

[b]The 1.2.0 update fixed a bug where obelisks were not unique for each of your save files.[/b][size=3] This also means that any saved obelisks in the 1.1.0 format won't work with the 1.2.0 format. Sorry about the inconvenience![/size]
[size=3]Guide for upgrading from 1.1.0 to 1.2.0:[/size]
[list=1]
[*]Load the save where the obelisk used to be. Do whatever you need to do for the day, then go to sleep.
[*]After you wake up, close the game and go to the Stardew Valley\Mods folder.
[*]Copy and paste the contents of DesertObelisk\savedObelisks.json into DesertObelisk\saves\<your character name>_<some number>_savedObelisks.json.
[*]You're all set, you can now delete DesertObelisk\savedObelisks.json.
[/list]

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/users/44734342?tab=user+files][size=5]Check out my other mods by clicking here![/size][/url]

Downloads.Description: Place in your Stardew Valley/Mods folder to install. Requires SMAPI v2.9+. Make sure not to delete your existing 'saves' folder.
